description: Apply the exact prepared change_id. If routine saves are enabled, ordinary user-requested changes save directly without a website approval; show the nutrition values in chat then log them. Otherwise return saved:false and the review link until the user approves. Deletions always need three website confirmations; never automate them. Safe to retry the same change_id; never change its meaning or use a stale proposal. Account conflicts require a fresh preparation from current data. Only saved:true proves completion.
name: apply_change
title: Save a requested nutrition change
